Cost: Super Luxury at minimum (Corgo lists it as [REDACTED])

External Frame only. Connecting needs three Interface Plug installations, and putting it on or taking it off takes 3 Actions. While connected: BODY becomes 14 and MOVE becomes 6 unless yours is higher (both automated while equipped); REF, DEX, and MOVE penalties from worn armor and wielded weapons are halved (rounded up); and it works as Jump Boosters, Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrades (Legs), and Skate Feet. The BODY increase doesn't change HP or your Death Save; the sheet may recalculate them, so check and correct by hand. With both hands on its controls, you run two back-mounted robotic arms that act as Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mounts, each aimed independently at anything you can see. Weapons in them are always One-Handed, count as connected for Smart Rebuilds and Smartgun Links, and can't be knocked away by Aimed Shots. It's Hardened (immune to EMP, Microwavers, and Black-ICE-style effects) and can't be Quickhacked or disabled by netrunning; a coded manual release on the chest extracts an injured pilot. Either arm can instead hold a custom Advanced Optical Shield (a 25 HP Bulletproof Shield that counts as two active FBC Chameleon Coatings when seen from the front beyond 25m/yds), or the EX-75 IronWind or EX-76 EarthBreaker, which only work in this frame. Priced at the Super Luxury minimum.

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo lists no exact price; see Cost.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > External Linear Frames).
